raw_text: China constructs new bridge near Pangong Tso in eastern Ladakh, satellite images reveal. New Delhi: China has constructed a new bridge near the strategically important Pangong Tso lake in eastern Ladakh, according to satellite imagery reviewed by NDTV. The bridge, located near what is known as Finger 8, connects the northern and southern banks of the lake on the Chinese side of the Line of Actual Control. Defence sources said the Indian Army is monitoring the development. The bridge is likely to improve China's ability to move troops and equipment in the region. India had built its own bridge across the lake last year.
